text:
eslint:
  rules:
    no-console: warn
    prefer-const: error

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: app-config
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: "info"
  ENABLE_TELEMETRY: "false"

openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Core Typing Engine API
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /v1/sessions:
    post:
      summary: Create new typing session
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Created successfully

default_settings: &defaults
  timeout: 30
  retries: 3
  logging: true

production:
  <<: *defaults
  database_url: "postgres://prod-db:5432/main"

staging:
  <<: *defaults
  database_url: "postgres://stage-db:5432/main"
source: JSON/YAML: DRY Configuration with Anchors and Merge Keys

text:
name: CI Pipeline
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm test
source: JSON/YAML: GitHub Actions Workflow with PNPM

version: "3.9"
services:
  app:
    build: .
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8080/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3

source: JSON/YAML: JSON Schema draft-07 type validation spec

text:
replicaCount: 3
image:
  repository: registry.internal/typing-app
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  tag: "v1.0.0"
ingress:
  enabled: true
  className: nginx
  hosts:
    - host: typing.domain.com
      paths:
        - path: /
          pathType: ImplementationSpecific

tauri:
  bundle:
    active: true
    targets: all
    identifier: "com.typingfree.app"
  security:
    csp: "default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: asset:;"

stages:
  - build
  - test
  - deploy

build_artifact:
  stage: build
  script:
    - pnpm install
    - pnpm build
  artifacts:
    paths:
      - dist/
    expire_in: 1 week
source: JSON/YAML: GitLab CI pipeline stage definition
